newsitem.title: USA: Virginia lawmaker proposes cigarette tax hike.
newsitem.headline: Virginia lawmaker proposes cigarette tax hike.

text.p: A Virginia state Senator has filed a bill to increase the state's tax on cigarettes by 10 cents a pack over four years, the Pilot newspaper reported Friday.
The bill by Sen. Madison Marye, D-Montgomery County, would raise the cigarette tax by 2.5 cents a pack each year until 2001, adding $60 million annually to state coffers.
"I don't thinks would disrupt tobacco sales and we need the money. I think it's the right plce to look for a little extra revenue," said Marye, a former smoker who kicked the habit 30 years ago.
However, Marye conceded, "Unfortunately, I seem to have a habit of putting in bills that don't stand much chance of passage."
Virginia currently has the lowest cigarette tax in the nation, 2.5 cents per package.
Washington state has the highest, 81.5 cents a pack, while the nationwide median is 31 cents a pack, the newspaper said.
